svg.aria-label: pyrox-lgm on the GeoStack role ladder: inla(), the Laplace fit, the log posterior of the hyperparameters, the diagnostics and each component's NumPyro face as algorithms; the components, PC priors, likelihoods, the model and the fitted results as models; no strategy objects, since inla() takes string options; the result's predictions, draws and xarray view and a component's prior and field as primitives; the structure spectrum and gaussx's GMRFs as structure. Beside the ladder, the setup that builds components and spectra, and kernellib's graphs.
svg.title: pyrox-lgm on the role ladder
